professionalService.problemSolved: Let an architect or client read one drawn street elevation as a sunlit, materialized house and follow its front door through actual room relationships to the rear courtyard.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: The same townhouse drawing gains depth, brick and physically related shadow; a reversible camera route tests entry, parlour, atrium and garden continuity.
professionalService.decisionValue: Can clarify facade depth, orientation, shadow and room sequence in project review. Donor address, area, status and booking call to action are authored copy, not verified Rubik project facts.

evidence.statement: The drawn No. 7 elevation becomes materialized and the route reaches its courtyard.
Pinned take describes depth, material, sun movement and front-to-back walk.

continuityInvariants.statement: The same doorway, balcony and stacked windows survive oblique depth and paper-to-brick transformation.

evidence.statement: Front door partially open.
Continuous reception view.

continuityInvariants.statement: Rear glazing and tree remain related as doors open and camera enters the same walled courtyard.

evidence.statement: Doors opening from atrium.
Courtyard end.
